title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 10: Early-Career Supplement on Earnings Guarantees
content:
**10.1** A locked guarantee recorded on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings guarantee opt-in includes an early-career supplement, which follows the lifetime trips recorded on the driver's driver services agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**: fewer than 1000 lifetime trips adds 20.00; at least 1000 but fewer than 3000 adds 10.00; 3000 or more adds nothing.

**10.2** The supplement is a fixed amount in USD. It is added to the guaranteed amount stated on the offer once that stated amount has been multiplied by whatever scales apply to it; the supplement itself is never scaled, and the sum is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**10.3** In figures, by lifetime trips on the agreement: 0 to 999 trips, 20.00; 1000 to 2999 trips, 10.00; 3000 trips or more, 0.00. The lines fall so that 999 trips still earn 20.00 and 1000 trips earn 10.00, and 2999 trips still earn 10.00 while 3000 trips earn nothing.

**10.4** *Hypothetical application.* A stated guaranteed amount of 200.00, scaled by 0.9 to 180.00, for a driver with 640 lifetime trips becomes 200.00 with the supplement (180.00 and 20.00 added together); the 20.00 is added as it stands, unscaled. The same scaled 180.00 for a driver with 3150 lifetime trips stays 180.00.
